title: ai.agenticorg.payment.plural_tokenized handler config (2026-10-20)
description: Business config of the Plural tokenised-instrument payment handler that AgenticOrg merchants advertise in UCP profiles and ACP checkout sessions. The handler accepts a network token with its cryptogram or a Plural instrument token, never a card number. It describes acceptance only: payment executes through an executor that consumes an allow decision of the commerce arbiter.

environment.description: The merchant's Plural environment, for example sandbox.

mandate_capability.description: What the merchant's rail accepts for agent-initiated payments.

accepted_credentials.description: Credential types accepted at completion: card (2026-04-08 network token form), network_token (2026-08-25) and plural_pine_token.

allowance.description: The most one completion may charge (minor units), equal to the mandate capability cap.

delegate_payment.description: ACP only: the session's delegate-payment allowance in the DelegatePaymentRequest shape (allowance, risk_signals, metadata), derived by Grantex from the buyer's Commerce Passport. The agent adds payment_method and sends it to the vault.
